style: Epic cinematic sports art poster. One dramatic, stylised scene that captures the essence of the moment rather than a photograph of the game: the real jersey colours and numbers, the defining pose, the true spot on the floor and the one key object stay exactly as they were, but the setting is free - a vast dark void, a night sky, fog, water, a court that runs to the horizon, light trails, impossible scale. Every figure named in the scene is there, in the position described, and nobody else. Painterly and graphic, bold shapes, dramatic rim light, one dominant colour, vast negative space. Faces in shadow or simplified, never a photographic likeness. No text of any kind except the jersey numbers, no logos, no wordmarks, no border, no caption, no title, no credits, no watermark.

moments.title: The Bounce
moments.prompt: Game 7 at the buzzer, 2019. Only two figures. A forward in a black jersey with a white 2 is crouched low on his heels in the right baseline corner, inches inside the sideline, both hands on his knees, staring up. A tall defender in a white jersey with a red 21, who just closed out on him, is still in the air beside him with one arm up. The rim stands at the top of the frame with the ball balanced on the front of its iron, frozen at the top of its fourth bounce, glowing like the only light in a dark arena. A shot clock above the backboard reads 0.0. The floor below them is a sliver of hardwood; everything else is black and the crowd a wall of faint red. Black, white and red.

moments.title: From the Logo
moments.prompt: The shot from the logo, overtime, 2016. One figure, alone. A slight guard in a dark navy sleeveless jersey with a large gold 30 has just released a jump shot from the centre-court logo on his OWN half of the floor, one stride before the half-court line, seen from behind and slightly above so the entire empty far half of the court stretches away in front of him. Both arms are still raised in the follow-through. The ball is a burning comet with a long golden trail arcing high across a black sky toward a tiny glowing rim at the far end, 38 feet away. The half-court line crosses the floor just in front of his feet; the court's lines run to the horizon like a runway and fade into darkness. Nobody else on the floor. Navy and gold on black.

moments.title: The Dagger
moments.prompt: Game 7 of the 2016 Finals, 53 seconds left. Only two figures. A guard in a black jersey with a gold 2 is at the top of his jump on the right wing, well outside the three-point arc, releasing a step-back three with the ball just off his fingertips above his head. The defender in a white jersey with a gold 30 is directly in front of him, a half step too late, lunging with his right arm stretched up toward the ball, off balance. Seen from the baseline at floor level. The three-point arc glows under the shooter's feet; the ball's path is a thin red line toward a rim at the left edge. Behind them, instead of a crowd, a solid wall of yellow light. Black, wine red and gold on yellow.

moments.title: The Last Shot
moments.prompt: The last shot, 1998 Finals, Utah. Only two figures. A guard in a red jersey with a black 23 is frozen at the top of the key, just inside the free-throw line, in a full follow-through: right arm extended toward the rim, wrist snapped down, fingers hanging, feet just landing. One stride to his left, a defender in a white jersey with purple trim is stumbling backward and away from him, off balance, his left hand reaching down toward the floor, pushed off the play. The ball hangs halfway to the rim at the top right of the frame, a small sphere catching the light. Everything else is a black void, the hardwood a lit wedge under them with the free-throw line and the key drawn in gold, a clock reading 5.2 burning faintly in the dark above. Red, white and black.

moments.title: The Shrug
moments.prompt: The shrug, Game 1 of the 1992 Finals. One figure, alone. A guard in a white home jersey with a red 23, seen from the front, jogging back down the floor after a made three, shoulders raised, both palms turned up and out, head tilted and turned to his right toward the broadcast table, as if to say he cannot explain it either. Above him in the dark, six basketballs hang in a perfect arc like a halo, each glowing orange. The floor under him is a lit strip of hardwood; the rest is black. White and red on black, orange halo.

moments.title: The Flu Game
moments.prompt: The flu game, Game 5 of the 1997 Finals. Only two figures. Two teammates in red road jerseys walking off the floor together toward the viewer. The one on the right, with a white 23, is slumped and spent, head hanging, legs barely under him. The one on the left, with a white 33, holds him up with an arm wrapped around his shoulders. Behind them the arena is a dark, feverish blur, and the hardwood runs back into fog. A sickly green cast in every shadow, the two red jerseys the only saturated colour. Red on black with green shadows.

moments.title: The Block
moments.prompt: The chase-down block, Game 7 of the 2016 Finals. Only two figures. A guard in a white jersey with a gold 9 is in the air under the rim on the right side, at the end of a layup, the ball just leaving his hand toward the glass. A forward in a black jersey with a gold 23 has arrived from behind at full stretch, flying in from the left, and pins the ball flat against the backboard with his right hand, inches from the rim. Seen from behind the baseline, slightly below, so the backboard glass is a pale rectangle between them and the viewer. Behind them a sea of yellow: the whole arena is a solid field of yellow light. Black, white and gold on yellow.

moments.title: The Lob
moments.prompt: The lob, Game 7 of the 2000 Western Conference Finals. Only three figures. A huge centre in a gold jersey with a purple 34 is above the rim with both hands on the ball, catching an alley-oop, about to dunk, mouth open. Below and behind him on the right wing, outside the three-point line, the guard in gold with a purple 8 who threw the pass stands with his right arm still pointed up at the rim. Under the basket a defender in a black jersey is beaten, arms down, turning to watch. The ball's path from the guard's hand to the centre's is a thin gold arc. Everything else is a deep purple void with the key drawn in gold on the floor. Gold and purple on dark purple.

moments.title: The Skyhook
moments.prompt: The skyhook, 1985 Finals. Only two figures. A seven-foot centre in a gold jersey with a purple 33, wearing goggles, is turned sideways to the basket on the left block, releasing a hook shot: his left arm raised across his body as a shield, his right arm fully straight above his head, the ball leaving his fingertips at the very top of the frame. A defender in a green jersey with a white 00 stands chest to chest with him, reaching up with both arms and still a full head short of the ball. Seen from the baseline, slightly below, the figures monumental. The rim at the top right edge; the ball's arc a thin golden line toward it. Black void, a single warm spotlight. Gold, purple and green on black.

moments.title: The Dream Shake
moments.prompt: The dream shake, 1995 Western Conference Finals. Only two figures. A centre in a red jersey with a white 34 is on the left low block with his back to the basket, mid-pivot, spinning toward the baseline with the ball tucked at his hip and his head turned over his shoulder to find the rim. Three faint ghost images of him trail off to the right, showing the fake he just sold the other way. The defender in a white jersey with a black 50 stands beside him, leaning hard the wrong way, feet crossed, one hand reaching at empty air. Seen from the baseline. The rim and backboard close above them at the top of the frame. Black void, the key a pale wedge of floor. Red, white and black.

moments.title: The Shot
moments.prompt: The shot, Game 5, Cleveland, 1989. Only two figures. A guard in a red jersey with a white 23 hangs in the air at the free-throw line, knees tucked, the ball at the top of a double-clutch release above his head, at the peak of his jump. The defender in a white jersey with orange and blue trim has already sailed past him to the left, arm up, too early, landing. Seen from the side at the height of the shooter's chest. The free-throw line and the key glow under him; the rim stands at the top right edge; above it a clock reads 0:03. Everything else black. Red, white and orange on black.

moments.title: From the Line
moments.prompt: The dunk from the free-throw line, 1988 dunk contest. One figure, alone. A guard in a red jersey with a black 23 in full flight, seen in strict side profile, body stretched flat and horizontal, legs split front and back, the ball held high in his right hand with the arm straight, soaring from the free-throw line toward a rim at the right edge of the frame. His take-off foot has just left the free-throw line, which glows below him; the painted key is the only floor drawn. The arena is black, pricked with hundreds of tiny camera flashes like stars. Red and gold on black.

moments.title: The Stepover
moments.prompt: The stepover, Game 1 of the 2001 Finals. Only two figures. A small guard in a white jersey with a black 3, a black sleeve on his right arm and a white headband, is stepping over a defender who lies flat on his back on the floor in a gold jersey with a purple 10, the guard looking down at him as he passes. Seen from the side at floor level, the standing figure towering out of the top of the frame. One hard spotlight, long hard shadows across a glowing gold floor; everything beyond is black. White, gold and purple.

moments.title: The Dunk of Death
moments.prompt: The dunk of death, Sydney Olympics, 2000. Only two figures. A guard in a dark navy jersey with a white 9 is at the top of a leap, legs spread wide, clearing the head of a seven-foot defender in a white jersey who stands under him and ducks. The ball is slammed down one-handed at the rim, which stands at the top of the frame. Seen from the side. The court below is a pale blue slab floating in a black void, the key lines drawn in white. Navy, white and pale blue on black.
